name: house_animate
doc: One frame of a building's moving parts, in closed form: signs, banners, laundry, awnings, and the tent's flap sway in the trees' gusts; wheels and sails spin (sails faster in the wind) and the weathervane points downwind; smoke puffs rise, swell, drift, and fade; the door opens for a visit when door_time starts; glows flicker.
